what: 44,000 dots pinned behind the screen (22,000 on touch devices) return from a scattered starfield (radius 2~6.5) over 2.8s, each delayed 0~.55 with cubic out (1.4rad swirl), and settle into an upper-body figure attached to the bottom of the screen (90% height). With each scroll screen they morph via smoothstep into a globe (evenly spread sphere, radius height×.42, .06 turns per second), a map (a slanted peninsula), and a double helix (rungs 1/6, rotating .6rad per second, strands roughening with scroll speed). For 2.5 screens after the helix, the helix slides sideways while the camera rotates in by π/7. fx:state mixes in tunnel (helix laid forward and back), frame (a rectangle around the text box scrolled past), and ring (loader — 2% of dots gather on 20 ring slots, rotating 1.2rad per second with a size wave). The head turns toward the mouse (.16, limit .22, follow .35s, release 1.1s, sways at .12 when idle) and dots around the cursor brighten 3x.

options.coarse: Share to keep on touch devices, default .6 (one in two)
options.start · each: Scroll where the first shape change starts (in screen heights) and the length used per shape, default 1 · 1 — upper body→globe 1~2, globe→map 2~3, map→spiral 3~4
options.slide: Distance the spiral slides sideways (screen height), default 2.5
options.formation: Initial condensing duration (s), default 2.8 — near 0 means instant
options.fill · width-fill: Share of height and width the upper body takes up, default .9 · .92
options.turn · max-turn · idle: Strength · limit · idle sway (rad) of head turning with the mouse, default .16 · .22 · .12
options.follow · settle: Time constants (sec) for following the mouse · returning on release, default .35 · 1.1
options.glow · glow-radius: Highlight strength·radius around the cursor (screen coordinates), default 2 · 1
options.scroll-scale · scroll-rotate: Share by which the upper body scales and the rotation angle as the Hero scrolls down, default .2 · -.6
options.globe-radius · globe-spin · map-offset: Earth radius (share of height), turns per second, map vertical offset, defaults .42 · .06 · -.04
options.fx:state: On the element, CustomEvent('fx:state', { detail: { ring, tunnel, frame, rect } }) — ring·tunnel·frame are 0~1 blends, rect is the getBoundingClientRect() of the text to be boxed
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (selector) — if none, one is created inside the element

note: The original reads bust and map-point files extracted from photos. Here we only measured the original silhouette’s per-band widths and point shares and filled them in with our own calculation: a bust (head, curly hair, neck, shoulders, light from upper left) and our own drawn peninsula map. To change the shape files, replace bust() and landmass(). Blending and rotation run in the vertex shader, and the dot pattern is a round glow with smoothstep(.5,.05) added with additive blending. Scroll only reads the window (window.scrollY). With reduced motion it resolves immediately and ignores the mouse. The consumer sets the element to position: fixed.; Place it behind the body (z-index 0) with inset: 0

from.where: index.html .id-scene (original .particle-scene — loader ring · upper body · globe · map · spiral · tunnel · squares around the mail)
